header.description: FAM-22 second half (modItemParse): parsed names matched to Items rows, best shop and value, Item Manager rows (AddSectionItems, PopulateItemManagerFromParsed, LV_AddRowByItemNumber), ExtractShopsFromObtainedFrom, EvaluateBestPriceForHit, GetBestShopNumForItem, SumInvOrCarriedQtyForName; ParseActionAndQty; GetShopRoomNames.
notes: Needs the stock database plus invented rows (db_extra: Items 9001+, Shops 9001+); data holds the rows the cases can reach (every Items row whose name is looked up, the shops they list, those shops' rooms, the classes used) for the Rust test, in table order.

The Item Manager is frmMain.lvItemManager, a mutable ListView shim; a case reads it back with %lv.lvItemManager (rows: text and sub items with the Value and Worn tags). LV_AssignRowSeqIfMissing (hidden row-sequence column) is a no-op.

ItemIsUsableByChar is cut from frmMain.frm and reached as frmMain.ItemIsUsableByChar from AddOneRow; the character is the cmbGlobalClass, txtGlobalLevel, cmbGlobalAlignment and txtGlobalMinLVL controls plus nEquippedItem.
A case's msgbox lists the MsgBox answers in the order MME asks (6 Yes, 7 No); without it the default button answers (Yes, Yes, and No for the clear question). Boxes and handled errors are in events.
The charm is frmMain.txtCharStats(5).Tag. Generated by tools/oracle/gen/item_match.py.
